diverge.owner: The Elected Reeve at Evangephoros holds because Elected Reeve is still the heavier of the two, and the weighing is done again every season.
diverge.stripped: The question of who might replace the Elected Reeve at Evangephoros does not come up, because there is nobody the village would name if it did.

diverge.owner: The Church Council at Goranitsa holds because Church Council is still the heavier of the two, and the weighing is done again every season.
diverge.stripped: Nobody at Goranitsa is in a position to take Church Council's place; it has no rival, and nobody in the town is asking who comes next.

diverge.owner: Llanbridge has people who would take the hall if they could. They cannot, and everyone involved knows it.
diverge.stripped: People at Llanbridge grumble, but nobody in the village stands ready to lead them, so Elected Reeve is safe in the hall.
